notes.title: LIFESPAWN Out Now!
notes.content:
LIFESPAWN is out right now! 

Jump your way from grassy fields to rustic killhouses, climb to the heights of a skyscraper and dive deep into the depths of hidden sewers in one long, long level. However, there are no checkpoints. Instead, you have 3 placeable hearts that you'll respawn at when you die. 3 hearts, one level and a world of heartbreak and rage may be your future depending on your heart placement.

Check it out!
